name: NIST CFReDS
what: Reference data sets with documented contents, made for testing tools and practising examinations.

name: Digital Corpora
what: Disk images, memory dumps, network captures and scenario data sets for education and research.

name: MemLabs
what: A series of capture-the-flag style labs for learning memory forensics.

name: DFIR Artifact Museum
what: A community archive of sample artifacts from many operating systems.

name: EVTX-ATTACK-SAMPLES
what: Windows event log samples for known attack techniques, good for testing log hunting tools.

name: CyberDefenders
what: Blue-team challenges with downloadable evidence. Some labs are free.

name: NIST Computer Forensics Tool Testing (CFTT)
what: Test reports and methods for validating forensic tools. Read these before trusting any tool in a real case.

name: Ali Hadi DFIR datasets
what: Free disk, memory and network challenge images with scenarios, widely used in DFIR teaching.

name: Josh Hickman's Android and iOS test images
what: Documented Android and iOS phone images made for testing mobile forensic tools.

name: DFIR Madness case images
what: Case-based challenges with disk and memory images and write-ups.

name: Security Datasets (OTRF)
what: Recorded Windows and cloud attack telemetry (event logs) for practising detection and log analysis.

name: Belkasoft CTFs
what: Free capture-the-flag challenges with downloadable images; any tool can be used.

name: M57-Patents scenario
what: A multi-week company scenario with disk images, memory and network captures for full-case practice.

name: AboutDFIR challenges and CTF list
what: A maintained list of current and past DFIR challenges and CTFs.
